name: F3 lined pond (off-creek)
notes: Off-creek pond beside the channel on the F3 flat, lined with Brett's 1.5 mm HDPE. About 11 x 12 m at the water line, 1 m deep, 2:1 sides: about 90 m3 (90,000 L). Water line about 52.9 m, floor about 51.9 m, bund crest about 53.3 m on the creek (east) side. About 130 m3 dug, about 40 m3 into the bund. Liner about 16 x 17 m (250 m2) with a 0.5 m anchor trench; weld patches and seams; geotextile or sand underneath; soil cover on the sides. Floor is only about 0.3 m above the creek bed: keep it part-full or add an under-drain so groundwater can't lift the liner. Filled by pipe from the W12 weir pool; spillway back to the creek below W14. From the 2022 LiDAR: check levels on site and water approvals first.
